title: Paper Books or E-books?
subtitle: 考点：阅读方式 / advantage, in general, come across
passage: Anna and her brother Ben both love reading, but in different ways. Anna prefers paper books. She likes the smell of paper, and she can write notes beside the lines. In general, she finds it easier to remember what she reads on paper. Ben likes e-books. His tablet holds hundreds of books, so he never carries a heavy bag.

Ben also has other advantages. He can click on a hard word and see its meaning at once. Sometimes he comes across a new word in a story and learns it in seconds. However, his eyes get tired after a long time on the screen. Their mother says, 'Both ways are good. The most important thing is to read every day.'
vocab: e-book 电子书 · tablet 平板电脑 · advantage 优点 · in general 总的来说 · click 点击 · screen 屏幕
